steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: The Ge—the doctor will be here soon.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*...

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: Are you crying, Viviana?

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: I don't think I have the strength to wipe away your tears anymore.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: You're too kind, too gentle...

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: I often think back to the day we first met.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: I had come from Zwillingstürme to Sturmland just to take you out of Werner's spire. You huddled in the back seat, holding onto your tiny suitcase and leaning gently against my chest.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: I was wondering: Was this little girl scared to leave her father? *cough* Scared of life in foreign Kazimierz?

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: But no. You were just trying to stay low, so no one would see your horns and cause trouble for Werner.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: Even though it was so late at night, and no one would have paid attention to a car leaving the great spires of the Kurfürst.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: You were so little back then...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I don't remember that.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: Nein. You do.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: You can lament, you can blame, you can mourn, you can regret, you can rage... *cough* All that, and only then can you...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Please... don't leave me...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You're the only one I have left.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: Let me 'see' you... one last time.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I'm right here.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: I'm so glad I can't see the expression on your face right now...

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: You deserve a better life than this, Viviana... If there really is one...
Tall as the empress's tower is, it is not endless. Or so she believes.
The spiral staircase extends before her, but direction itself seems to be torn apart by some unknown, irreversible power. She keeps moving forward, but she can't make any progress.
Viviana is tired, and when one is tired, it is easy to notice what one has lost.
Not unlike the twenty-two years of her life.
Are you lost?
Viviana looks up.
She sees a young Caprinae woman, whose face is filled with curiosity and concern.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Sorry, I must have bumped into you in my hurry.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: It's alright.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Are you okay? You look very pale.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I'm fine... I was just thinking about something.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Do you know this place well?

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Ja, I live nearby.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Where does this lead?

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Didn't you come here on your own?

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Where it leads is entirely up to where you want to go.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Take care, now. I'll be going.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Where I want to go...
Viviana's fingers brush the handrail next to her. Ochre paint covers the emblem of Urtica under a thick layer of dust, so bright it could have been painted yesterday.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: The Witch King.
She recalls the historical novel Die Glut.
When the Witch King first ascended to the throne, he gave his builders a blueprint of the Genesis Spire, a monument so great, the likes of which Leithanien had never seen.
Simply gazing upon the plans was enough to make one short of breath, as though standing before its foundation.
The Witch King was scrupulous about every last detail of the Genesis Spire, down to the materials and paints used for every fence and railing, which must never fade in color.
It would become the sole symbol of Leithanien.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Has the Genesis Horn fully descended?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: But that woman just now...
Viviana comes to a startling realization.

The Caprinae who just passed by was like one of the young people living on the outskirts of Zwillingstürme. In the prime of her life, busy and tireless, her voice emanating the warmth of a fresh cup of tea.
She should not be here. Neither at the empress' spire, nor in the Genesis Horn.
Viviana turns around. No one is there.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: What about you, Viviana?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Why are you here?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Why did you come back to Leithanien? Why did you leave?

a.text: You couldn't say goodbye to your father. You couldn't return to the spire of your childhood, that tower you memorized along with the rain and wet moss.
You watched Cora die in your arms. You couldn't take her away from this dusk-scorched city.
What can you stop? What can you change? What can you possibly accomplish?
If the Witch King isn't dead, if he sits at the end of this endless spiral, would you beg him for enlightenment, just like those fanatics?
It really does sound a bit absurd.

steps.text: The staircase stretches on and on... until Viviana sees a door in an inconspicuous corner.
A tiny, familiar door.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Attempting to turn left at each intersection, to ensure progress through continuous deviation.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Unsuccessful.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Attempting to descend.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Failed to reach bottom of staircase after forty-five minutes. Attempt unsuccessful.
Federico has spent a long time on the staircase of the empress's spire. He stops in his tracks after yet another failed attempt.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: At the most basic level, Arts are a rigid form of order.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The Twin Empresses would not have hired a mentally ill architect to design their Spires, and no artificer could have recreated such orderless architecture.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: My judgment was impaired due to my experience at Ludwigs-Universität's Sonata Spire... The distortion occurring within this tower is unrelated to Arts.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Has the Genesis Horn covered the entire spire, causing changes in reality?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Arturia's music is also absent...
After a brief pause, Federico pulls out his shotgun and fires in front of him.
The sound of the gunshot fills the space, but the projectiles vanish right before his eyes, as though wiped away by some formless something.
Herr Sankta!

As he hears the sound, Federico sees the projectiles again, now moving with a slow and clear trajectory, like a rock skipping across the water. Ripples spread, and everything beneath the surface is revealed.

steps.name: Anxious Woman
steps.text: Phew—

steps.name: Anxious Woman
steps.text: Put away your gun, please!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Anxious Woman
steps.text: Put away your gun, please!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I do not require you to repeat yourself.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I've heard something similar from everyone I met on this mission.

steps.name: Anxious Woman
steps.text: Of course you did. This is Zwillingstürme, not Laterano.

steps.name: Anxious Woman
steps.text: Loris always liked to talk about Laterano. He said that when the Sankta go out, they 'bang' any buildings they don't like, and 'bang' the buildings they do like even more eagerly.

spans.text: Loris always liked to talk about Laterano. He said that when the Sankta go out, they 'bang' any buildings they don't like, and 'bang' the buildings they

steps.name: Anxious Woman
steps.text: Jan and I used to think he was making things up because he didn't like his hometown very much.

steps.name: Anxious Woman
steps.text: Anyway, look around you.

steps.name: Anxious Woman
steps.text: Zwillingstürme is an old city. Any brick or tile could have a score or a poem etched on it by a drunk artist from a century ago.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: This is...
Federico quickly assesses the sight before him.
If this place is the Genesis Horn, where the Witch King's legacy is kept, Arturia's final destination...
Then it is difficult to believe that his bullets could have broken through some sort of barrier and brought him here from that strange staircase.
Federico examines the woman before him. The anger on her face is no more and no less than that of a citizen performing her civic duty to stop a rude tourist.

steps.name: Anxious Woman
steps.text: Do you understand me, Herr Sankta? Put away your gun... please.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: We are clearly not on the streets of Zwillingstürme, but you seem unaware of this.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You have mentioned a Loris and a Jan. Assuming you are referring to Loris Bordin and Jan Schüler...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Please, tell me your name.

steps.name: Anxious Woman
steps.text: Yulia... Yulia Schüler.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: This is inside the Genesis Horn? The Witch King's resting place?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: But the Witch King...

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Stop looking around, little angel.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You caught up... I'm not surprised.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: I wish I could say the same. The last thing I expected was for you to actually cling to a Lich's thread and be voluntarily Exiled.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: So where is the Witch King?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Dead. What else?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: No, I should be able to sense him. His Arts, his emotions, his will... if I just...
Arturia looks around. It is a space without boundaries, defined by only indescribable flows of light like the respiration of the void.
She steadies her cello, puts her hand on the strings, and sets her bow.
Silence.
Bow touches string, but the vibration produces no sound. The motion familiar to her, so natural, has lost all meaning here.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Finally noticed?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I can't play.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I've... lost my music.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Is it because of the Genesis Horn? Or the 'rules' of the Witch King?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Arrogant. Foolish. Witless. That petty halo over your head is shedding light on your pale face. I wish it could do the same to your brain.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Where do you think you are right now?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Inside Herkunftshorn's coffin? A treasure trove of the Pashas of Sargon? A witch's magic pocket from a Victorian fairy tale?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Herr Fremont...

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: (Sarkaz) 'The beginning and end of all threads.'
As though muttering to himself, Fremont speaks an unfamiliar word in Sarkaz.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Or maybe the name he gave it would be more in line with your understanding.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: (Leithanian) Desolate Domain.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Kargereich?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: What you're seeing is the other side of the 'real,' a dimension always in flux. Any rule, any reality disintegrates before it in an instant.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Through the long eons, the Liches have caught only glimpses of it, and despite Herkunftshorn's life's work, the best he could manage was to create a tiny, volatile bubble in this infinite void.
Arturia does not respond to Fremont's anger. She simply touches the strings again. The unbroken hush.
There is no disappointment or fear, only confusion.
An emotion that only flashes across Arturia's face before she looks up and smiles.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Perfect.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: So the Witch King didn't prolong his will through mystical arts, but instead created his own retreat in Kargereich.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: This pocket still exists, so he must be here... It's just that there's still a ways to go to reach his throne.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: ...Aren't you curious what happens if you're Exiled again in Kargereich?
Arturia realizes that the shadows are growing.
The Lich's witchcraft had been moving while she was speaking. Thread-like shadows grow into thick vines around Fremont, merging into the ambiguous colors of the ground, and begin to come at her.
Death and extinction. Decay in its full bloom.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: ...I still haven't found my answer.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I have to rediscover my music. I must perform the Witch King.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I can't...
...die yet.
She is perfectly willing to meet her end performing. But what she can't accept is to fade into silence, with the truth so near.
The shadows crack, and a gray rain rushes up to engulf all.

steps.name: The Witch King's Musician
steps.text: Der Wiener Uhrturm rings!

steps.name: The Witch King's Musician
steps.text: Go, to the Genesis Spire! The performance begins—

steps.name: The Witch King's Musician
steps.text: New music, new Arts... protecting Vedunien against Catastrophe and the cannons of Gaul...

steps.name: The Witch King's Musician
steps.text: Herk... Herkunftshorn...

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Reality is unstable here.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Was it caused by the Exile?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: No, it was like this before we entered Kargereich. Herkunftshorn's power is diminishing.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: ...The Genesis Horn's collapse is accelerating.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Argh—!

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I'm... still alive?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: The melody... it's gone...
She clung to the one string of sound distinct from the environment, and escaped the threads of Exile.
Now, the melody has become tangible, emerging from the void and descending before her.
It has taken human form.
(Unintelligible sounds)

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Was it your melody that saved my life?
(Unintelligible sounds)

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Were you... a spire caster of the Witch King?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Th-The Witch King?!

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: How could you think that?!

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: ...I'm sorry.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Careful, keep your voice down.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Is someone after you?

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: You're hurt... stay put and hide here.

steps.name: Yulia
steps.text: Don't worry, I know this place well. No one will find it.
